```{r}
# Chunk para librerias
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(car)
library(glmnet)
library(pROC)
library(MLmetrics)
```


```{r}
# Cargar los datos
train <- read.csv("train.csv")

# Configurar la semilla para reproducibilidad
set.seed(245)
porciento <- 0.7
corte <- sample(nrow(train), nrow(train) * porciento)
train_data <- train[corte, ]
test_data <- train[-corte, ]

# Crear variable categórica (usando el mismo método que en KNN.Rmd)
mean_price <- mean(train_data$SalePrice, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_price <- sd(train_data$SalePrice, na.rm = TRUE)
lower_limit <- median(train_data$SalePrice)
upper_limit <- mad(train_data$SalePrice)

train_data$Category <- ifelse(train_data$SalePrice < (lower_limit - upper_limit), "Baratas",
                        ifelse(train_data$SalePrice > (lower_limit + upper_limit), "Caras", "Medianas"))

test_data$Category <- ifelse(test_data$SalePrice < (lower_limit - upper_limit), "Baratas",
                       ifelse(test_data$SalePrice > (lower_limit + upper_limit), "Caras", "Medianas"))

# Crear variables dicotómicas por cada categoría
train_data$Es_Cara <- ifelse(train_data$Category == "Caras", 1, 0)
train_data$Es_Media <- ifelse(train_data$Category == "Medianas", 1, 0)
train_data$Es_Barata <- ifelse(train_data$Category == "Baratas", 1, 0)

test_data$Es_Cara <- ifelse(test_data$Category == "Caras", 1, 0)
test_data$Es_Media <- ifelse(test_data$Category == "Medianas", 1, 0)
test_data$Es_Barata <- ifelse(test_data$Category == "Baratas", 1, 0)

# Mostrar distribución de las nuevas variables
table(train_data$Es_Cara)
table(train_data$Es_Media)
table(train_data$Es_Barata)
```
